scope: US and Hong Kong; free sources; personal research

sec.usage: public filing data; point-in-time availability must be validated before historical training
sec.notes: 8-K primary documents are cover pages; exhibits require a separate authorized import.

fred.usage: macro series; vintage availability must be validated per series

eastmoney.usage: personal research; vendor-defined fields; no redistribution
eastmoney.notes: Use raw prices (fqt=0) only; never use the vendor adjusted series as truth.

tiingo.usage: additional US vendor where the free entitlement applies; no news entitlement assumed

finnhub.usage: licensed API; sharing derived results is restricted; headlines are context only

gdelt.usage: article metadata with attribution; original publication time is not guaranteed

hkma.usage: official releases; context unless a historical availability record exists

census.usage: background statistics only; not a high-frequency stock factor

user_import.usage: material supplied by the user; import is allowed only for the stated personal research purpose

ken_french.usage: user-authorized local public factor archives for personal risk attribution; publication times not presumed known

hk_yahoo.reason: HK data must not come from Yahoo, including prices, actions and estimates.

hkexnews_automation.reason: HKEXnews terms prohibit automated access, scraping, text mining and AI training. Use user-supplied or licensed material.

cboe.reason: Usage eligibility is unresolved; advance approval may be required. Do not enable by default.

ecb_tls_bypass.reason: TLS verification must never be disabled.
